blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Cebu Football Club (Cebu FC) looks to build on its first victory of the season when it takes on Mendiola FC in the Philippines Football League (PFL) Season 2026-2027 on Wednesday, November 4, at the Rizal Memorial Football Stadium in Manila. The Gentle Giants will kick off at 5:45 p.m. hoping to carry the momentum of their 6-0 demolition of Tuloy FC last October 18 into their next assignment. After suffering back-to-back defeats to open their campaign, Cebu FC finally got on the winning track with a dominant performance that showcased their attacking depth. READ ALSO: Cebu FC […]...
